item.title: exit 0 in sourced cmd-init.sh kills parent shell
item.intent: Sourced modules must never kill the parent process — use return, not exit, so the orchestrator can handle errors gracefully.
item.description: cmd-init.sh line 285 uses 'exit 0' when the user declines reinit. Since modules are loaded via source, exit terminates the entire orchestrator process instead of just returning from the function. Must replace with return 0.
steps: Replace exit 0 with return 0 at cmd-init.sh line 285
Audit all other lib modules for exit statements that should be return
Verify no exit calls remain in any sourced module function

acceptanceCriteria.text: No exit statement exists in any sourced module function body
cmd-init.sh uses return 0 instead of exit 0 for user cancellation
